name: Indicator lamp
summary: A visual indicator associated with a documented control or equipment condition.
description: An indicator lamp shows an operating condition defined by its circuit and label. The generic representation identifies an indicating element; it does not define what illumination means, the supply voltage or whether the device is continuously lit or flashing.

A schematic should explain the condition driving the indication. The front-panel description should match the electrical label, so a reviewer can follow the indication from operator interface to contact, relay or controller output.
readingNotes: Read the text describing the indicated condition.
Follow the circuit supplying the lamp and identify any flashing or test function.
drawingChecklist: Reference the supply and device type.
Align schematic identification with the panel layout.
distinction: An indication mark does not establish that equipment is safe, isolated or de-energised. Its meaning comes from the full circuit and operating documentation.

facts.label: Meaning
facts.value: Defined by label and control circuit
